# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## External communications

- Do not independently contact third parties on the user's behalf. This includes vendors, upstream projects, maintainers, support or legal contacts, email recipients, and public issue trackers.
- Do not send messages, submit inquiries or reports, or create or comment on external tickets unless the user explicitly approves that specific communication first.
- Reading publicly available documentation is not considered contact, but never imply that an external party has reviewed or approved the project unless documented evidence supports that claim.
